$ FIXTURE_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test  # chain-a
    The root-package check for the module-root corpus runs in normal runs, so it runs after the update: go test ./...
    export/faulty: import's jenny fails on the export, with an error decl.Reject doesn't mark.
        import: Imports the export as a script, as its import/ tree says.
        import's jenny failed on the case, with an error that is no rejection:
          import: the generator's error
        If import rejects the case, return the error as decl.Reject(err). If not, fix import's jenny. An update writes nothing for this cell.
    export/faulty: import's jenny fails on the export, with an error decl.Reject doesn't mark.
        parse: Parses the script, as its parse/ tree says.
        The update writes nothing for the cell of the lift import, on parse's path: the lift's cell says why, in the package that owns it. A normal run reads the product and the outcome the archive commits for import, so the update writes nothing for this cell either, and the cell runs nothing.
        Fix what import's cell reports.
    export/faulty: import's jenny fails on the export, with an error decl.Reject doesn't mark.

        The update writes nothing for the cell of the lift import, on resolve's path: the lift's cell says why, in the package that owns it. A normal run reads the product and the outcome the archive commits for import, so the update writes nothing for this cell either, and the cell runs nothing.
        Fix what import's cell reports.
